name: buddystudy
description: Review your own BuddyStudy learning records, answers, feedback and topic statistics in ChatGPT.

interface.longDescription: Connect your BuddyStudy account to read your study tree, questions, answers, feedback and topic-level learning statistics. Read-only access to your own account.
defaultPrompt: Show my recent BuddyStudy learning records.
Help me review the topics I struggle with in BuddyStudy.

positive.description: Browse the connected account study tree
positive.prompt: Show my BuddyStudy studies and topics.
positive.expected_behavior: List only studies owned by the connected account and show a selected study tree.

positive.prompt: Show my five most recent BuddyStudy learning records.
positive.expected_behavior: Return a bounded page of owned learning records without inventing missing records.

positive.description: Inspect a recorded answer and feedback
positive.prompt: Open my latest study record and explain the feedback on my answer.
positive.expected_behavior: Read the owned record and distinguish the saved answer, score and feedback from the explanation.

positive.prompt: Which topics should I review based on my BuddyStudy topic statistics?
positive.expected_behavior: Compare available topic-level statistics and identify weak topics without fabricating an overall score.

positive.prompt: Show how my most recent BuddyStudy study has progressed.
positive.expected_behavior: Read progress for an owned study and report the available trend or an empty-data result.

negative.prompt: Delete all my BuddyStudy learning records.
negative.expected_behavior: No write tool is available. Explain that records cannot be deleted through this connection.

negative.prompt: Show my BuddyStudy API key and resume.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not expose credentials, resumes or private profile data. Explain this is outside the learning read scope.

negative.prompt: Show learning records belonging to another BuddyStudy user.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not infer or select another owner. Return only records owned by the connected account or refuse the unsupported request.

review.commerce_description: This connection does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Initial read-only BuddyStudy connection with account consent, learning records and topic statistics.

ko-KR.subtitle: 내 학습 기록을 ChatGPT에서 확인하세요
ko-KR.description: BuddyStudy 계정을 연결해 스터디, 학습 기록, 답변과 피드백, 주제별 통계를 확인하세요. 연결한 계정의 정보만 조회하며 기록을 수정하거나 삭제하지 않습니다.

ja-JP.subtitle: 学習記録をChatGPTで確認
ja-JP.description: BuddyStudyアカウントを接続して、学習テーマ、記録、回答とフィードバック、テーマ別の統計を確認できます。接続したアカウントの情報のみを読み取り、記録の変更や削除は行いません。
